text: What is the main difference between internal trade and international trade?
options: Internal trade involves trade between two or more countries.
Internal trade involves trade within a country.
International trade involves trade between two or more countries.
International trade involves trade within a country.
explanation: Internal trade is the trade that takes place within a country, whereas international trade is the trade that takes place between two or more countries. This is because internal trade involves the exchange of goods and services between different regions or states within a country, whereas international trade involves the exchange of goods and services between different countries.
subject: Business Studies

text: What is the scope of international business?
options: It involves the production and sale of goods and services within a country.
It involves the production and sale of goods and services between two or more countries.
It involves the production and sale of goods and services within a region.
It involves the production and sale of goods and services within a state.
explanation: The scope of international business is broad and encompasses all aspects of business that involve the production and sale of goods and services between two or more countries. This includes import and export of goods and services, foreign investment, international marketing, and global supply chain management.
subject: Business Studies

text: What is the purpose of a letter of credit?
options: It is a document that proves the ownership of goods.
It is a document that proves the payment of goods.
It is a document that guarantees payment to the seller upon presentation of the documents.
It is a document that guarantees payment to the buyer upon presentation of the documents.
explanation: A letter of credit is a document that guarantees payment to the seller upon presentation of the documents. It is a financial instrument that ensures that the buyer will pay for the goods or services received, thereby reducing the risk of non-payment for the seller.
subject: Business Studies

text: What is the purpose of a bill of lading?
options: It is a document that proves the ownership of goods.
It is a document that proves the payment of goods.
It is a document that serves as a receipt for the goods shipped.
It is a document that serves as a receipt for the goods received.
explanation: A bill of lading is a document that serves as a receipt for the goods shipped. It is a contract between the shipper and the carrier that outlines the terms and conditions of the shipment, including the type of goods, the quantity, and the destination.
subject: Business Studies

text: What is the purpose of a shipping bill?
options: It is a document that proves the ownership of goods.
It is a document that proves the payment of goods.
It is a document that serves as a receipt for the goods shipped.
It is a document that serves as a declaration of the goods being exported.
explanation: A shipping bill is a document that serves as a declaration of the goods being exported. It is a customs declaration that outlines the type of goods, the quantity, and the value of the goods being exported.
subject: Business Studies

text: What is the World Trade Organization (WTO)?
options: It is an international organization that promotes free trade between countries.
It is an international organization that regulates trade between countries.
It is an international organization that provides financial assistance to countries.
It is an international organization that provides technical assistance to countries.
explanation: The World Trade Organization (WTO) is an international organization that promotes free trade between countries. It was established in 1995 to replace the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) and its main objective is to reduce trade barriers and promote free trade among its member countries.
subject: Business Studies

text: What is the International Monetary Fund (IMF)?
options: It is an international organization that promotes free trade between countries.
It is an international organization that regulates trade between countries.
It is an international organization that provides financial assistance to countries.
It is an international organization that provides technical assistance to countries.
explanation: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) is an international organization that provides financial assistance to countries. It was established in 1944 to promote international monetary cooperation and exchange rate stability, and its main objective is to provide financial assistance to countries facing balance of payments difficulties.
subject: Business Studies

It is an international organization that provides financial assistance to countries.

text: What is the main advantage of international trade?
options: It allows countries to specialize in the production of goods and services in which they have a comparative advantage.
It allows countries to produce all goods and services domestically.
It allows countries to import goods and services from other countries.
It allows countries to export goods and services to other countries.
explanation: The main advantage of international trade is that it allows countries to specialize in the production of goods and services in which they have a comparative advantage. This leads to increased efficiency and productivity, as countries can focus on producing goods and services in which they have a comparative advantage.
subject: Business Studies

text: What is the main disadvantage of international trade?
options: It can lead to job losses in domestic industries.
It can lead to increased efficiency and productivity in domestic industries.
It can lead to increased competition in domestic markets.
It can lead to reduced prices of goods and services in domestic markets.
explanation: The main disadvantage of international trade is that it can lead to job losses in domestic industries. When countries import goods and services from other countries, it can lead to job losses in domestic industries that produce similar goods and services.
subject: Business Studies

text: What is the concept of comparative advantage?
options: It refers to the ability of a country to produce a good or service at a lower opportunity cost than other countries.
It refers to the ability of a country to produce a good or service at a higher opportunity cost than other countries.
It refers to the ability of a country to produce a good or service at the same opportunity cost as other countries.
It refers to the ability of a country to produce a good or service at a higher price than other countries.
explanation: The concept of comparative advantage refers to the ability of a country to produce a good or service at a lower opportunity cost than other countries. Opportunity cost is the value of the next best alternative that is given up when a choice is made.
subject: Business Studies
